findings.summary: Low-contrast small grey text on dark background makes law-ceiling and trading-fee lines hard to read
Many tracks, including bond tracks, show 'less than 3 years' instead of a return, blocking comparison
No explicit low-risk labeling; reader inferred it from 0% shares
Highest return (13.7%) on all-shares S&P 500 track draws the eye
Two similar-coloured rings in shares/FX column with unclear meaning
Returns shown before management fees, so net return is unknown
Too many numbers per row; long RTL lines hard to follow
Repeated list of folds when scrolling; page ends without a conclusion
